verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual mailbox SaaS, and a service like this could plausibly offer an API or CLI for headless automation, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes interactive use through a phone app or web portal ("a few taps", "from your phone or computer"). The probes for an OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt file both returned 404, so there is no evidence of any headless, CI or programmatic interface.
